component.name: Steam Artwork for Non-Steam Games
component.summary: Artwork and icons for your non-Steam games

description.p: Gives the games you added to Steam yourself (emulators, GOG, itch.io, Heroic and Lutris installs) the same artwork as the rest of your library: cover, wide cover, banner, logo and icon, from SteamGridDB.

It finds your Steam install on its own, lists every non-Steam shortcut, and fills in whatever is missing in one click. You can swap any piece from a visual picker and undo any change. Steam's shortcut list is backed up before every write.
Works on desktop Linux and on the Steam Deck in desktop mode. Needs a free SteamGridDB API key. Not affiliated with Valve or SteamGridDB.
